description: Investigates learning-to-learn frameworks, few-shot classification, metric-based, model-based, and optimization-based meta-learning algorithms such as MAML.
learning_objectives: Understand meta-learning concepts, N-way K-shot benchmarks, and task-distribution sampling.
Implement metric-based meta-learning including Siamese, Prototypical, and Matching Networks.
Master optimization-based meta-learning including MAML, FOMAML, Reptile, and Meta-SGD.
Apply meta-learning to few-shot vision, meta-reinforcement learning, and AutoML.
outline: Meta-Learning Foundations: Learning-to-learn paradigms, N-way K-shot tasks, few-shot benchmarks (Omniglot, mini-ImageNet).
Metric-Based Approaches: Siamese Networks, Matching Networks, Prototypical Networks, Relation Networks.
Model-Based Approaches: Memory-Augmented Neural Networks (MANN), Meta Networks, Neural Turing Machines.
Optimization-Based Approaches: Model-Agnostic Meta-Learning (MAML), First-Order MAML (FOMAML), Reptile, Meta-SGD, implicit gradients (iMAML).
Bayesian Meta-Learning: Probabilistic MAML, uncertainty quantification in few-shot regimes.
Applications: Meta-reinforcement learning, automated machine learning (AutoML), continuous learning.

books.title: Metalearning: Applications to Data Mining and Machine Learning
books.author: Pavel Brazdil, Jan N. van Rijn, Carlos Soares, Joaquin Vanschoren
